concept.title: People returning to exercise gently
concept.shortdesc: People who are out of practice, low in fitness or nervous about exercise and want an easy or low impact way back into activity.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.
